title: Memberships
summary: Sell memberships and day passes, confirm billing, and check members into a gym, studio, club or community.

entryPoints.summary: Sign in or create a member account.
See only your membership, payments and visits.
Find members and check active members in.
Add staff, plans, lists and import or export records.

owner.summary: Manages plans, staff and all club records.

staff.summary: Signs in for member lookup and check-in only.

member.summary: Signs up to join; sees only their own membership, payments and visits.

journeys.summary: Open the owner area through an owner pass.
Open the front desk and find members.
Open membership statuses and plan categories.
Join, follow the first-payment authorization link, and activate only after billing read-back; verified with the fake door.
Pause or cancel at period end through billing.
Deliver welcome, failed-renewal and cancellation emails.

notIncluded: Billing is off by default. Requires the platform door, a connected test account and PRAMAAN_PAYMENTS_TEST_MODE=true. The platform operator selects test credentials.
Billing changes attempt email delivery; the owner retries unsent messages. No background delivery or webhook processing. Billing refresh is explicit.
One membership per member. Changing plans or rejoining after cancellation is not included.
CSV imports up to 200 members per request; exports and visit history are limited to their documented result windows.
Real-account authorization and billing response compatibility are a deployment check; this kit uses the fake door and makes no live paid calls.
